title: Nice Sangria and Paella Experience with Marlon
text: Marlon was a great teacher. He taught us how to cook paella with real passion. The atmosphere felt very family-like, and we really enjoyed it. We would recommend it to anyone. The sangria was delicious and easy to make. We would definitely recommend a "smaller" cooking class like this over going to a formal cooking school. The vibe was just perfect. 👍
